sql: SELECT OrderID, Total FROM dbo.Orders;
SELECT o.OrderID, c.CustomerName FROM dbo.Orders o INNER JOIN dbo.Customers c ON o.CustomerID = c.CustomerID;
SELECT CustomerID, SUM(Total) AS GrandTotal FROM dbo.Orders GROUP BY CustomerID HAVING SUM(Total) > 100;
SELECT OrderID, Total FROM dbo.Orders ORDER BY OrderDate DESC;
WITH OrderSummary AS (SELECT CustomerID, COUNT(*) AS Cnt FROM dbo.Orders GROUP BY CustomerID) SELECT CustomerID, Cnt FROM OrderSummary;
CREATE TABLE #TempOrders (OrderID INT, Total DECIMAL(18,2)); SELECT OrderID, Total FROM #TempOrders;
DECLARE @tbl TABLE (ID INT, Name VARCHAR(50)); SELECT ID, Name FROM @tbl;
SELECT isactive INTO #temp FROM B00Layout; SELECT isactive FROM #temp;
SELECT TOP (10) OrderID, Total FROM dbo.Orders;
SELECT OrderID, CASE WHEN Total > 1000 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Low' END AS Category FROM dbo.Orders;
SELECT [OrderID], [Total] FROM [dbo].[Orders];
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CustomerID) FROM dbo.Orders;
SELECT o.OrderID FROM dbo.Orders o WHERE o.Total BETWEEN 50 AND 200;
SELECT o.OrderID FROM dbo.Orders o WHERE o.CustomerID IN (SELECT CustomerID FROM dbo.Customers);
SELECT o.OrderID, o.CustomerID FROM dbo.Orders o WHERE o.OrderDate IS NOT NULL;
SELECT o.OrderID, o.Total, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY o.CustomerID ORDER BY o.Total DESC) AS rn FROM dbo.Orders o;
SELECT o.OrderID FROM dbo.Orders o CROSS APPLY (SELECT ItemID FROM dbo.OrderItems i WHERE i.OrderID = o.OrderID) ca;
SELECT o.OrderID, c.CustomerName FROM dbo.Orders o LEFT JOIN dbo.Customers c ON o.CustomerID = c.CustomerID WHERE c.ContactEmail LIKE '%@corp.com';
INSERT INTO dbo.Orders (OrderID, CustomerID, Total) VALUES (1, 10, 50.0);
UPDATE dbo.Orders SET Total = 100.0 WHERE OrderID = 1;
DELETE FROM dbo.Orders WHERE OrderID = 1;
SELECT id, total FROM public.orders;
SELECT o.id, c.name FROM public.orders o JOIN public."Customers" c ON o.customer_id = c.id;
SELECT id, customer_id FROM public.orders WHERE order_date >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days';
SELECT id, total FROM public.orders LIMIT 10 OFFSET 5;
SELECT o.id, oi.price FROM public.orders o LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT price FROM public.order_items WHERE order_id = o.id) oi ON true;
INSERT INTO public.orders (id, customer_id, total) VALUES (1, 2, 99.9) ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING;
UPDATE public.orders SET total = 200 WHERE id = 1 RETURNING id, total;
CREATE TEMP TABLE tmp_cust (id INT, name TEXT); SELECT id, name FROM tmp_cust;
WITH regional_sales AS (SELECT id, name FROM sales.region) SELECT id, name FROM regional_sales;
SELECT o.OrderID FROM dbo.Orders o UNION ALL SELECT o.OrderID FROM dbo.Orders o;
SELECT o.OrderID, COALESCE(o.Total, 0) AS SafeTotal FROM dbo.Orders o;
SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR(20), o.OrderDate, 120) AS FmtDate FROM dbo.Orders o;
SELECT CAST(o.Total AS INT) AS IntTotal FROM dbo.Orders o;
SELECT o.OrderID FROM dbo.Orders o WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.OrderItems i WHERE i.OrderID = o.OrderID);
SELECT o.OrderID FROM dbo.Orders o WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.OrderItems i WHERE i.OrderID = o.OrderID);
SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY Total) OVER () AS MedianTotal FROM dbo.Orders;
SELECT o.OrderID FROM dbo.Orders AS o WITH (NOLOCK);
SELECT o.OrderID, (SELECT c.CustomerName FROM dbo.Customers c WHERE c.CustomerID = o.CustomerID) AS CustName FROM dbo.Orders o;
SELECT r.RegionName FROM sales.Region r;
